title: You Can Play GTA 6 on an Xbox One: Day-One Cloud Streaming Confirmed ☁️ #Shorts
description:
Xbox confirmed GTA 6 will stream through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S on day one, November 19 at 1 AM ET. Cloud streaming uses Xbox Series S graphics settings, and you still need to buy the game. Xbox also says GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store.

Source: Xbox Wire (Nov 10, 2026) - news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/10/grand-theft-auto-6-comes-to-xbox-cloud-gaming-november-19/
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
